bundle: WI-9 / L-036 — Infosys associates/JV carrying value and the POLICY_ZERO review control
question: Does the primary evidence establish an associates/JV carrying value for FY2024, FY2023 or FY2022, and are the POLICY_ZERO treatment and its 180-day review control correctly represented?

answers.why: In all three periods the audited consolidated statements recognise no equity-accounted interest: no balance-sheet caption (Ind AS 1 para 54(e)), no share-of-associates line in profit or loss or OCI (Ind AS 1 para 82(c) / Ind AS 28), and a Note 2.5 decomposition that ties to the filed investment totals to the rupee in every period (24,623 / 19,478 / 20,324). An absent caption is not a nil, and D-2 forbids turning it into one.

rejectedCandidates.why: aggregate treasury and minority holdings, fully decomposed into Ind AS 109 categories; no equity-accounted component
treasury portfolio totals including current instruments
minority stakes and fund interests carried at fair value; fair value is incompatible with the equity method
a listed minority holding at FVOCI; no significant influence asserted
an annexure to the standalone statements, absent from the audited consolidated statements

rejectedCandidates.candidate: ownership percentages or associate results applied to a total
rejectedCandidates.why: forbidden by the work item and by D-2; nothing was inferred

rejectedCandidates.candidate: a nil declared from the omission
rejectedCandidates.why: the nil grammar requires the filer's own wording, a filing reference and a period; no sentence declares this balance nil

reviewControl.anchor: clockStart = the newest balance-sheet instant in the dataset (DATASET_PERIOD_END), never an execution timestamp
reviewControl.boundaryEvidence: 179 days NOT_DUE, 180 days REVIEW_DUE, 181 days REVIEW_DUE (tests/investment/assessment-valuation-integrity.test.ts)
reviewControl.inertnessEvidence: valuation.intrinsic.perShare and valuation.marginOfSafety are byte-identical to the Work Item 3 artifact

productDefectFoundAndCorrected.finding: Dataset schema V2 — the remedy IX declared for L-036 — could not be exercised by an operator: the ingest CLI never passed a datasetSchema, writeDataset never recorded the content's grammar in the manifest, and readDataset never restored it, so a V2 dataset written to disk was read back as V1 and its carrying value would have been refused.
productDefectFoundAndCorrected.correction: ingest.ts gained an optional --dataset-schema (absent = V1, unknown = fail closed); writeDataset records the grammar; readDataset restores it. No policy, no D-2 semantic, no grammar, no valuation rule and no default changed.
productDefectFoundAndCorrected.proofV1Unchanged: WI-3's committed dataset reproduces byte-for-byte (all ten files, including manifest.json) and the V1 payload digest is unchanged at 9e7f621d…
productDefectFoundAndCorrected.proofV2Reachable: the same committed input ingested as V2 yields associatesAndJV MISSING/NOT_REPORTED instead of NOT_COMPUTABLE/NOT_REPORTED, with the same treatment and review status; no value was supplied
productDefectFoundAndCorrected.tests: tests/investment/cli.test.ts — 'the dataset grammar is declared by the operator, and defaults to the legacy V1 grammar'

payload.note: This is the current-code payload for the unchanged WI-3 dataset, captured for readback evidence only. The WI-3 artifact stays byte-identical and remains the historical record.

valuationImpact.confidence: unchanged by this work item; the WI-3 artifact's 0.6736 differs from today's 0.4378 because the authorized IX assumption caps apply, which is IX's change, not this one
valuationImpact.why: no dataset value, no observation, no policy and no valuation rule was touched

limitationStatus.why: the carrying-value criterion is not met and cannot be met for this issuer by a number: the statements recognise no such asset, and an omission is not a nil. The representational half is now demonstrably reachable by an operator, and the control is verified in force and inert.
limitationStatus.whatWouldResolve: an issuer that files an equity-accounted carrying value (V2 now carries it end to end), or an issuer sentence declaring the balance nil, or a register-owner decision to grade an absent caption

verification.targetedTests: tests/investment/cli.test.ts 6/6; tests/investment/ixAuthorizedPolicy.test.ts, wi4AssociatesEvidence.test.ts, assessment-valuation-integrity.test.ts, dataset-schema-v2.test.ts all green
verification.readback: separate process, recomputed digest = stored digest = chain head
